claude_proposed_widenings.name: ObjectFilter.maxSize
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Light targets 'one Large or smaller object' — a size cap on the valid target objects. ObjectFilter has no size field, so the encoded spell silently widens to objects of any size.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You touch one Large or smaller object that isn't being worn or carried by someone else.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: DurationEndTrigger.caster_recasts_spell
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Light ends early when the caster casts it again. No existing DurationEndTrigger variant matches this. The v4 lifecycle atom replace_on_recast exists but has no surface hook on Duration.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: The spell ends if you cast it again.
